_note: Batch 12: ten REAL Perth fitness and movement providers researched from public information on 10 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'fitness' practice category: personal trainers, Pilates studios, barre, functional fitness, mobility coaching, stretch therapy, aqua fitness and tai chi/qigong for wellness. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. No body-transformation, weight-loss or health-outcome marketing is repeated (MH Performance's outcome claims deliberately omitted; copy sticks to formats, locations, schedules and prices). Dance movement therapy was researched but no individually verifiable Perth practitioner with a public practice page surfaced — only directory aggregators — so that subtype awaits a real listing. Como and Attadale added as suburbs.

listings.name: Revere Pilates Studio
listings.blurb: A boutique loft-style studio in East Victoria Park running mat, reformer, arc and barre classes alongside slower release sessions, with private and duo appointments for people who want the equipment to themselves. Teaching leans form-first and beginner-friendly.
listings._source: reverepilates.com.au — East Victoria Park location, class list and private/duo formats confirmed; bookings via Momence, prices/owner/phone not published

listings.name: Self Love Club Pilates Studio
listings.blurb: A Como studio founded by Maddie, a qualified physiotherapist and Pilates instructor, running reformer, aerial, mat and barre classes. The physio background shows in the programming — classes are built with technique and joint positioning in mind rather than pace for its own sake.
listings._source: selfloveclubpilates.com.au — Como location, founder's physiotherapy + Pilates qualifications and class list confirmed; prices and direct contact not captured

listings.name: Total Movement
listings.blurb: A purpose-built West Perth gym for functional strength and conditioning, coaching one-on-one and in semi-private sessions rather than big classes. Programming is written per person and adjusted to goals and lifestyle, with the coach across every session.
listings._source: tmovement.com.au — West Perth purpose-built facility, 1:1 and semi-private coaching model and per-person programming confirmed; prices and contact not captured

listings.name: MH Performance Coaching
listings.blurb: A personal training practice running since 2014 with studios in Myaree and Wangara, predominantly training women. Coaching takes a health-first line — strength sessions built alongside nutrition and daily-habit work rather than programs sold on before-and-after photos.
listings._source: mhperformancecoaching.com — founded 2014, Myaree and Wangara studios, women-focused training model confirmed; their body-transformation and health-outcome marketing is deliberately not repeated; prices and contact not captured

listings.name: Slings and Roundabouts
listings.blurb: Annelise coaches movement one-on-one using the Anatomy in Motion approach — assessing how someone actually moves, then building take-home movement strategies and personal programming — with bodywork, breath training and pregnancy movement coaching alongside, plus on-demand classes online.
listings._source: slingsandroundabouts.com.au — Anatomy in Motion training, 1:1 coaching model, breathwork and pregnancy coaching confirmed; suburb not stated (Perth used), bookings via Appointy with a free consult, prices unpublished

listings.name: Stretched
listings.blurb: An Applecross studio specialising in assisted fascial stretching — a practitioner moves you through supported stretches, blended with massage and soft-tissue techniques, in one-on-one sessions rather than classes.
listings._source: ClassPass studio page for Stretched (Applecross) — assisted fascial stretching specialty and one-on-one format confirmed; the studio's own domain wasn't located, so the ClassPass profile stands in until claimed

listings.name: StretchLab South Perth
listings.blurb: The South Perth studio of the assisted-stretching franchise, where trained 'flexologists' run 25 or 50-minute one-on-one stretch sessions on benches, working through the whole body or a chosen focus area.
listings._source: stretchlab.com.au/location/south-perth — South Perth location and one-on-one assisted stretch format confirmed; session lengths from their standard model; prices and local contact not captured

listings.name: Beatty Park Leisure Centre
listings.blurb: The City of Vincent's pool and fitness centre runs one of Perth's biggest aqua timetables — Aqua 4 All, Aqua Balance, Aqua Cardio, Aqua HIIT, Aqua Zumba and Deep Aqua — plus a 40-minute Stretch & Flex class, with casual entry from $12.40 concession and class packs available.
listings._source: beattypark.com.au — address, aqua class list, Stretch & Flex format, casual prices ($12.40 concession / $25.80 adult) and phone confirmed

listings.name: Chen Tai Chi Academy
listings.address: Club House @ Troy Park, 51 Burke Drive, Attadale WA 6156
listings.blurb: Chen-style tai chi in the Zhu Tiancai lineage, taught through a ten-week beginner program aligned with WA school terms — posture, breathing, silk reeling and the 13 Postures routine — at Troy Park in Attadale on Saturday mornings, with a second venue in Safety Bay. Beginner classes run on donation; annual membership is $40.
listings._source: chen-taiji.com — Attadale venue and address, 10-week term-aligned program, Saturday 9–10.30am schedule, donation-based beginner classes, $40 annual membership and $30 intermediate classes confirmed; contact is WhatsApp only

listings.name: Chinese Kung Fu & Tai Chi Academy
listings.blurb: A martial arts school teaching tai chi and qigong alongside kung fu for more than twenty years, with academies in Balcatta and Fremantle. The tai chi and qigong streams sit at the wellness end of the practice — slow-form work for balance, breath and focus, for adults and children.
listings._source: chinesekungfu.com.au — Balcatta and Fremantle academies, 20+ year history and tai chi/qigong programs for adults and children confirmed; prices and direct contact not captured
